capability_profile.retained_database_profile: sequence 8 one-table nullable signed-i32 database, including insert/select/update/delete and NULL-preserving snapshots
capability_profile.expression_result: one materialized integer result (0 or 1) or one materialized NULL result, exposed through result_get and result_is_null
semantics: IN over an empty list is false, including for a NULL left operand
NOT IN over an empty list is true, including for a NULL left operand
a matching non-NULL element decides true for IN and false for NOT IN
without a match, NULL on either side yields NULL
without a match or NULL, IN is false and NOT IN is true
signed i32 boundaries and leading-zero decimal forms are accepted
capability_profile.input_staging_contract: SQL bytes must be staged in host-owned non-overlapping memory. Existing short-query tests use [0,4096); large-query tests use the unused high-memory region beginning at 32768. Because WebAssembly memory is exported, a host that writes across database-owned regions can corrupt state before execute is called.
unsupported_expression_forms: uppercase NULL in this scalar-expression parser
whitespace variants outside the declared grammar
broader_unsupported_database_features: ordering, grouping, joins, aggregates, indexes, constraints, and transactions

pinned_sqllogictest_family.selection_rule: all query records whose SQL is a scalar signed-integer-or-NULL literal [NOT] IN an empty or comma-separated signed-integer/NULL literal list
pinned_sqllogictest_family.claim_boundary: This is a complete coherent expression family within the pinned file, not conformance with the entire in1.test file or SQLLogicTest corpus.

sqlite_generated_differential.generation_domain: signed integers in [-1000,1000], NULL left operands, zero-to-nine-element lists, duplicate-capable integer/NULL lists, and both IN and NOT IN

verified: sequence 8 nullable insert/select/update/delete behavior remains model-equivalent
scalar expression evaluation does not mutate table state

promotion.source_free_policy: Only raw Wasm bytes, binary metadata, runtime behavior, and test data were used; no implementation source, WAT, compiler input, generator file, or decompiled source was created or inspected.
